title: FATHER GOD, TAKE OVER EVERY BATTLE THAT IS BEYOND MY STRENGTH
text: Beloved, before we go into the depths of this prophetic hour, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this prayer with someone. There is somebody connected to your life. Maybe in your family, maybe in your workplace, maybe somebody you've never met physically, but you're connected to them in [music] the realm of the spirit. And the Lord wants to use this word to break limitations over their lives. Share it now. Don't wait until after we finish. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes that there is a time and a season for everything under heaven. And this is the season of divine intervention. [music] For somebody reading this right now, share it. And as you share it, you are releasing a prophetic seed [music] that will attract angelic attention to your own battles. Glory to God. Now, lift up your hands wherever you are. I don't care where you are reading this from. Whether you are in your room, whether you are in traffic, whether you're in the office, lift up your hands right now because we are about to enter into a realm of prayer that will shift the [music] atmosphere around your life. The title of our ministration is, "Father, take over every battle that is beyond my strength." And I want you to understand something. The fact that you are drawn to this word is not an accident. It is a divine orchestration. There are battles in your life right now that have defied your education, [music] that have defied your connections, that have defied your efforts. And God is saying to you today, "Step aside. Let me take over." You see, one of the greatest revelations that a believer can come into is the understanding that there are dimensions of warfare that are beyond human capacity. The Bible is full of examples of battles that men could not win [music] until God stepped in. When you look at the children of Israel at the Red Sea, they were trapped. Pharaoh's army was behind them. The Red Sea was before them. The wilderness was on either side. And there was no exit strategy. Moses didn't have a battle plan. Moses didn't have military training. Moses didn't have weapons [music] that could match the Egyptian chariots. But Moses had access to the God who divide seas. And when God took over that battle, Pharaoh's entire army was swallowed up in one night. Somebody shout take over, Lord. Now I want you to understand the theology of divine takeover. When we say, "Father, take over," we are not speaking from a place of weakness. Even though we acknowledge our limitations, we are speaking from a place of spiritual intelligence. You see, there is a difference between giving up and handing over. When you give up, you resign. When you hand over, you are strategically positioning yourself for a greater force to intervene. In the military, when a smaller battalion is overwhelmed by the enemy, they call for air support. They don't stop fighting. They keep holding the line, but they call for reinforcements that have superior firepower. That is what we are doing in this hour. We are calling for divine air [music] support. We are calling for the God of angel armies to step into our battles. The Bible says in 2 Chronicles chapter 20, when Jehoshaphat was surrounded by three armies, the Moabites, the Ammonites, and the people of Mount Sea, he did something very instructional. The Bible says he proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah. And the people came together to seek the Lord. And Jehoshaphat prayed a prayer that I want you to pray with me today. He said, "Oh our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power against this great multitude that is coming against us, nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are upon you. Did you see that? We have no power, nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are upon you. That is the posture of a person who is activating divine takeover. Now, let me show you what happened next. When Jehoshaphat had finished praying, the spirit of the Lord came upon Jehaziel and he prophesied. He said, "Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours but God's. Tomorrow go down against them. You will not need to fight in this battle. Position yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord who is with you." And the Bible says that when they went out [music] the next day, God had already set ambushes against their enemies and they destroyed one another. Judah didn't lift a sword. They only gathered the spoils for three days. Somebody shout, "The battle is not mine." I decree over your life today that every battle that is [music] beyond your strength is about to experience divine takeover in the name of Jesus. That situation in your family that has been going on for generations where it seems like every solution you apply makes it worse. I declare divine takeover. That sickness in your body that the doctors have tried everything and the reports keep coming back negative. I declare divine takeover. That financial siege where it seems like every door you knock on closes in your face. I declare divine takeover in the mighty name of Jesus. But now I want to take you deeper. There are conditions for divine takeover. God does not take over battles where he's not invited. God does not violate your will. You must intentionally and consciously hand over that battle to him. And when I say hand over, I don't mean pray once and then go back to worrying. I mean a complete absolute irrevocable transfer of that burden from your shoulders to his. The Bible says in 1 Peter 5:7, "Cast all your anxiety on him because he [music] cares for you." The word cast there is not a gentle suggestion. It is a violent throwing off. It means to haul it away from yourself. Stop carrying what God has asked you to cast. Stop meditating on battles that God has asked you to hand over to him. Now, let me give you the prayer structure that activates divine takeover. The first thing you [music] must do is acknowledge your limitation. You see in our generation we have been taught to confess strength even when we are weak. We have been taught to say I can do all things and that is true but through Christ who strengthens [music] us not through our own power. There is a humility that attracts divine intervention. When you come before God and you say Lord I have done everything I know to do and this battle is still standing. You [music] are not demonstrating lack of faith. You are demonstrating spiritual maturity. You are saying I know my limits and I know you have none. The second thing you must do is declare God's ownership of the battle. You see the moment you became a child of God, everything concerning you became God's concern. The Bible says we are bought with a price. You don't belong to yourself anymore. Your battles are not your battles. Your challenges are not your challenges. They are God's challenges because you are his property. So when the enemy comes against you, he's not coming against you. He's coming against the God who owns you. And when God defends what belongs to him, he does it with fullness of power and glory. Thirdly, you must position yourself in worship and thanksgiving. Look at what Jehoshaphat did after he received the prophecy. The Bible says he appointed singers to go before the army singing and praising the Lord. Not after the victory, before the victory. They were worshiping their way into a battle they had been told not to fight. There is something about worship that creates an atmosphere where God [music] moves. The Bible says God inhabits the praises of his people. When you begin to praise God in the middle of your battle, you are inviting his presence into that situation. And where the presence of God is, demons cannot stand. Where the [music] presence of God is, impossibilities bow. Let me prophesy to somebody. The reason that battle has lasted so long is because you have been fighting it with human strategies. You have been fighting it with worry. You have been fighting it with manipulation. You have been fighting it with your own wisdom. But today, God is calling you into a new dimension. He's calling you into a dimension where you stop [music] fighting and you start worshiping. He's calling you into a dimension where you stop strategizing and you start [music] prophesying. He's calling you into a dimension where you stop explaining your problem to people and you start declaring God's promises over that situation. Now, I want to pray with you. But before I pray, I want you to identify that battle right now. Don't pray a general prayer. Identify it by name. Is it a health battle? Is it a marital battle? Is it a financial battle? Is it a battle for [music] the destiny of your children? Is it a battle over your mind, over depression, over anxiety, over fear? Whatever it is, I want you to see it in your spirit right now. See it clearly. And now I want you to make a decision today. I am handing this battle over to God. [music] I am no longer carrying it. I am no longer worrying about it. I am no longer losing sleep over it. Today by faith I transfer this burden to the one who said, "Come to [music] me all you who are weary and burdened and I will give you rest." Now lift your hands and pray with me. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace today. Not in my own righteousness, but in the righteousness of your son, Jesus Christ. I acknowledge that I am standing before battles that are beyond my strength. I acknowledge that I have tried everything I know to try, and [music] these battles are still standing. But Lord, I have come to a place of surrender. I have come to a place where I am no longer trusting in my own ability. I am trusting in your unlimited power. I am trusting in your infallible wisdom. I am trusting in your covenant faithfulness. Lord, your word says in Psalm 121 that my help comes from you, the maker of heaven and earth. You are the God who does not sleep nor slumber. You are the God who watches over me day and night. And so today, Father, I am calling for divine takeover. I am calling for divine intervention. I am calling for divine disruption of every satanic agenda against my life. Every battle that has been assigned to wear me down, to discourage me, to make me give up on your promises. Father, I hand it over to you right now in the name of Jesus. Lord, you [music] are the God who said to Moses, "Why are you crying to me? Tell the children of Israel to go forward." You are the God who said to Joshua, "Be strong and courageous, for I am with you wherever you go." You are the God who said to Gideon, "The Lord is with you, mighty warrior." [music] You are the God who said to David, "The battle is the Lord's." And today, Father, I am standing on these same promises. I am declaring that my battles belong to you. I am declaring that my challenges are too small for your greatness. I am declaring that my enemies are nothing before your power. Father, I pray for divine wisdom in situations where I do [music] not know what to do. Your word says in James chapter 1 that if any man lacks wisdom, [music] let him ask of you and you will give it liberally without reproach. So right now I am asking for wisdom. I am asking for divine strategies. I am asking for prophetic insights that will give me advantage over my adversaries. Let your spirit guide me into all truth. [snorts] Let your spirit show me things to come. Let your spirit teach me how to navigate through these battles with supernatural intelligence. Lord, I pray for divine strength where I'm weak. Your word says in Isaiah 40 that you give power to the weak and to those who have no might, you increase strength. Even the youth shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall. But those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings like eagles. They shall run and not be weary. They shall walk and not faint. So, Father, I wait on you today. I wait for my strength to be renewed. I wait for fresh grace to [music] be released. I wait for fresh anointing to be poured out. Father, I come against every spirit of fear that is trying to paralyze me in the face of these battles. Your word says you have not given me a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. I reject fear. I reject anxiety. I reject panic. I reject every demonic projection that is trying to make me believe that these battles are bigger than they are. I declare that no weapon formed against me shall prosper. I declare that every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I shall condemn. I declare that this is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. Lord, I pray for angelic intervention. Your word says in Psalm 91 that you shall give your angels charge over me to keep me in all my ways. In their hands they shall bear me up lest I dash my foot against a stone. Father, I'm calling for angelic reinforcement right now. Let your waring angels go before me into every battle. Let them fight on my behalf. Let them execute your judgments [music] against my enemies. Let them bring confusion into the camp of my adversaries. Let them set ambushes against every ambush that has been set against me. Father, I pray for supernatural turnaround in situations that look hopeless. You are the God who makes ways where there is no way. You are the God who brings water [music] out of rocks. You are the God who causes iron to float. You are the God who opens blind eyes and deaf ears. You are the God who raises the dead. And so, Father, I am calling for resurrection power in every dead situation in my life. Let there be resurrection in my finances. Let there be resurrection in my health. Let there be resurrection in my family. Let there be resurrection in my destiny. Lord, I come against every limitation that is trying to define [music] my future. Every generational curse, every family pattern, every cycle of defeat, I break it in the name of Jesus. I declare that old things have passed away and all things have become new. I declare that I am a new creation in Christ Jesus. I declare that the former things shall not be remembered nor come to mind. I declare that God is doing a new thing in my life and now it shall spring forth. Father, I pray for divine vindication in situations where I have been falsely accused, where I have been misunderstood, where I have been misjudged. Your word says that vengeance is yours and you will repay. I don't need to defend myself when you are my defender. I don't need to fight for my reputation when you are the lifter of my head. So, Father, I commit my [music] cause to you. I commit my case to you. Let your righteousness shine forth as the light and your justice as the noonday sun. Lord, I pray for financial breakthrough where there has been financial blockage. Your word says that you wish above all things that I may prosper and be in health even as my soul prospers. Father, I reject every spirit of poverty. I reject every spirit [music] of lack. I reject every spirit of stagnation. I declare that you are Jehovah Gyra, my provider. I declare that you are El Shadai, the God who is more than enough. I declare that you are the God who owns the cattle on a thousand hills. And if you own it all, then my needs are not a problem [music] for you. Father, I speak to every closed door and I command them to open in the name of Jesus. Every opportunity that has been blocked, every connection that has been severed, every favor [music] that has been delayed, I call them forth by the authority in the name of Jesus. Let the gates be lifted up. Let the ancient doors be raised that the King of glory may come in. And as the King of glory comes into my situations, let him bring with him promotion, elevation, acceleration, and unprecedented breakthrough. Lord, I pray for healing where there is sickness. Your word says by your stripes we are healed. Father, I am not praying for healing. I am receiving what Jesus already purchased for me on the cross. Every sickness in my body, I command [music] you to leave now in the name of Jesus. Every disease, every infirmity, every pain, every discomfort, I command you to bow to the name of Jesus. I declare that my body is [music] the temple of the Holy Spirit. I declare that no plague shall come near my dwelling. I declare that I shall live and not die and I shall declare the works of the Lord. Father, I pray for my children, for my spouse, for my family members who are going through battles. I cover them with the blood of Jesus right now. I declare that no evil [music] shall befall them. I declare that you are watching over them day and night. I declare that your angels are encamped around them. I declare that they shall fulfill their destiny. I declare that they shall walk in the fullness of your purpose for their lives. Lord, I pray for deliverance from every satanic bondage. Every chain that has been holding me back, I break it by fire in the name of Jesus. [music] Every cord of wickedness, I cut it by the sword of the spirit. Every agreement I have made with darkness, knowingly or knowingly, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. Every covenant I have entered into through ignorance, through deception, through manipulation, I revoke it now in the name of Jesus. I declare that I am free. I declare that whom the son sets free is free indeed. Father, I pray for restoration of everything the [music] enemy has stolen. Your word says in Joel chapter 2 that you will restore the years that the locust have eaten. Father, I am calling for restoration. Restore my wasted [music] years. Restore my lost opportunities. Restore my stolen [music] blessings. Restore my joy. Restore my peace. Restore my health. Restore my wealth. Let there be a seven-fold restoration for everything that has been stolen from me. Lord, I pray for divine protection over my life, my family, my ministry, my business. Psalm 91 says that he who dwells in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. Father, I dwell in your secret place. I abide under your shadow. I declare that you are my refuge and my fortress. I declare that you are my God in whom I trust. I shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day, nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction [music] that waste at noon day. A thousand may fall at my side and 10,000 at my right hand, but it shall not come near me. Father, I pray against every spirit of discouragement, every spirit of depression, every spirit of hopelessness. [music] I reject them in the name of Jesus. I declare that the joy of the Lord is my strength. I declare that weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning. I declare that you have not given me a spirit of heaviness, but you have cloth me with a garment of praise. I declare that I am strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. Lord, I pray for divine favor in places where I've been rejected. Your word says that you make my enemies to be at peace with me. Father, I am calling for supernatural favor. Let me find favor with God and with man. Let doors open for me that no man can shut. Let opportunities locate me by divine arrangement. Let the right people be attracted to my life. Let divine connections be established. Let strategic relationships be formed. Father, I come against every spirit of confusion in my life. Your word says you are not the author of confusion but of peace. So I reject confusion about my future. I reject confusion about my purpose. I reject confusion about my decisions. I receive clarity by the spirit of God. I receive divine direction. I receive prophetic guidance. Your word says your sheep hear your voice. Father, let me hear your voice clearly. Let me know the way I should go. Lord, I pray for acceleration of every promise. You have spoken over my life. I declare that what was scheduled for 10 years from now shall happen within one year. I declare that divine speed is activated over my destiny. I declare that I shall overtake and recover all. I declare that the set time to favor me has come. I declare that this is my season of supernatural manifestation. Father, I pray against every satanic delay. Every plan of darkness to postpone my breakthrough, I cancel it [music] by fire. Every evil clock that has been set against my destiny, I destroy it by the blood of Jesus. Every calendar [music] of witchcraft monitoring my life, I set it ablaze by Holy Ghost fire. [music] I declare that my time has come. I declare that my season has arrived. I declare that what God has promised, he's able also to perform. Lord, I pray for divine wisdom to manage the victories you are about to give me. Let me not be like those who receive breakthrough and then lose it through foolishness. Give me the wisdom to steward my blessings. Give me the wisdom to maintain my victories. Give me the wisdom to walk in continuous progress. Father, I thank you because I know you are hearing this prayer. I thank you because your word says that if I ask anything according to your will, you hear me. And if you hear me, I know that I have the petitions I have asked of you. So I receive my answers now by faith. I declare that it is done. I declare that the battle is over. I declare that victory is mine. I declare that breakthrough has been released. I declare that the takeover is [music] complete. And now, Father, I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. Let no demon, no devil, no witch, no wizard, no marine spirit, no territorial spirit, no ancestral spirit, no familiar spirit, let none of them be able to reverse what we have prayed today. Let it be established in heaven and let it manifest on earth. As we have prayed on earth, let it be done in heaven. Let it be permanent. Let it be irreversible. Let it be non-negotiable. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I declare that from this moment forward, the battles that have been tormenting you are taken over by God. You will begin to see the salvation of the Lord. You will begin to see doors opening. You will begin to see favor manifesting. You will begin to see breakthrough appearing. You will begin to see testimonies emerging. This is your season of divine takeover. This is your season of supernatural intervention. This is your season of angelic reinforcement. Now, I want you to do something for the next seven days. Every morning when you wake up, the first thing you should say is, "Father, I thank you for taking over my battles." Don't wait to see the evidence. Thank him by faith. Worship him by faith. Praise him by faith. And as you do this consistently for 7 days, you will begin to see a shift in the atmosphere around your life. You will begin to see changes that you cannot explain. You will begin to experience interventions that you did not orchestrate. Somebody is reading this and within the next 3 weeks you are going to receive a phone call that will change your situation completely. The person calling you doesn't even know you yet, but God is already arranging that connection. Somebody is reading this and within the next 30 days you are going to receive a financial breakthrough that will shock you. is coming from a direction you are not looking at. God is about to surprise you. Somebody is reading this and the sickness that has been in your body is receiving it termination [music] notice today. By the time you go for your next medical checkup, the doctors will be confused because what they saw before will no longer be there. I decree and declare over your life, every battle that is beyond your strength is now under divine management. [music] You are entering into a season of rest. You are entering into a season of peace. You are entering into a season of joy. You are entering into a season of celebration. The Lord is taking over. The God of angel armies is taking over. The God who never loses a battle is taking over. And when God takes over, victory is guaranteed. When God takes over, breakthrough is inevitable. When God takes over, the enemy has no choice but to surrender. I see a vision right now in the realm of the spirit. I see chains breaking. I see yolks being destroyed. I see prison doors opening. I see captives [music] being set free. I see the glory of God flooding situations that have been dark for too long. I see light breaking forth in the midst of darkness. I see hope rising in the midst of despair. I see joy replacing sorrow. I see strength replacing weakness. I see victory replacing defeat. This is your season. This is your time. This is your moment and I declare that you will not miss it. You will not delay it. You will not postpone it. You will walk into [music] the fullness of what God has prepared for you. Every limitation is broken in the name of Jesus. Every barrier is removed in the name of Jesus. Every obstacle is dissolved in the name of Jesus. Now receive your breakthrough in the name of Jesus. Receive your healing in the name of Jesus. Receive your deliverance in the name of Jesus. Receive your restoration in the name of Jesus. It is done. It is finished. It is established. Amen and amen. Glory to God. Glory to God. Glory to God. Now go and share this prayer with someone who needs it. Be a channel of blessing. Be a carrier of this prophetic word. And as you share it, you are multiplying [music] your own breakthrough. The kingdom of God operates on the principle of sewing and reaping. As you sow this word into someone else's life, you are activating a harvest in your own life. Go now and be a blessing.
